title: openbb-mcp and sec-edgar-mcp build requirements do not pin mcp/httpx; a clean venv resolves an mcp that depends on httpx2 and PyInstaller copy_metadata('httpx') fails (PackageNotFoundError)
repro: Fresh worktree, fresh venv, `node scripts/ensure-all-sidecars.mjs --force` (or pnpm ci-local on a clean machine / CI): ensure-openbb-mcp-sidecar fails at copy_metadata('httpx').
evidence: batch-2 integrator built the two MCP venvs only by freezing constraints from the main worktree's working venv (mcp==1.27.1, httpx==0.28.1); see r15/stage-c/batch-2 integ.failures
fix_shape: Pin mcp and httpx (and their direct transitive pins that the recipes copy metadata for) in sidecar/openbb_mcp_subprocess/requirements.txt and sidecar/sec_edgar_mcp_subprocess/requirements.txt; make the ensure recipe fail with a named message when a copy_metadata target is missing; prove with a clean-venv build in the batch verifier.

title: /fundamentals for Indian symbols is ~2x slower after batch 2 (median 2-3 s rising to 4-8.5 s, max 18 s) because the ownership witness is uncached and runs on every request
repro: Two rounds of GET /fundamentals/{TCS,INFY,ITC,HDFCBANK,SBIN} with X-Vysted-Region: IN against a base (369faa7) sidecar and the batch-2 sidecar; compare time_total (r15/stage-c/batch-2/VERDICTS.md, b2v-logs/ab-fundamentals.txt).
fix_shape: Cache the witness result per (symbol, statement as-of) with the same TTL as the fundamentals row; never re-fetch the witness when the underlying row is served from cache; pin with a test that a second call within TTL makes no witness fetch.

title: Rows cached before a correctness fix keep being served for up to 24 h after the fix (fabricated SEC 10-K rows, the FOCUS merged split)
repro: Warm the cache on the pre-fix build, upgrade, request the same symbol: the pre-fix row is served as ok until its TTL expires.
fix_shape: Key provider caches on a provider-logic version (or schema version) so a fix invalidates its own stale rows; pin with a test that bumping the version misses the cache.

title: The 'half-yearly filer' TTM label also fires on quarterly filers
repro: GET /fundamentals for a quarterly Indian filer; the TTM field meta carries the half-yearly-filer label.
fix_shape: Derive the label from the observed filing cadence (statement period lengths), not from the region; pin with one quarterly and one half-yearly case.

title: yfinance get_quote still stamps as_of with now() instead of the provider's quote time
repro: GET /quotes/{symbol} outside market hours: as_of equals the request time, not the last trade time.
evidence: batch-2 verifier VERDICTS.md issues list (remaining after R15-DATA-006)
fix_shape: Use the provider's regularMarketTime (or the bar timestamp) as as_of; fall back to null with a reason, never now(); pin with a test on a closed-market fixture.

title: The _row_value helper still exists as a twin in two modules after batch 2
fix_shape: Keep one definition in the shared module and import it.
